title: EventEnvelope
description: C1: envelope shared by every JetStream message. Published on subject oe.<type>.<tenant_id> with header Nats-Msg-Id = id.

id.description: UUID v7, lowercase. Also the JetStream dedup key (Nats-Msg-Id).

type.description: Dotted event type, e.g. contacts.upserted. First segment picks the stream.

schema_version.description: Version of the data payload schema for this type.

occurred_at.description: RFC 3339 timestamp with exactly millisecond precision.

source.description: Name of the emitting service, e.g. core, tracker.

contact_id.description: Contact UUID, or null when the event is not tied to a contact.

trace_parent.description: Optional W3C Trace Context traceparent header value (version 00).
